units.source_text: 我心想：这回等待的是老师无法抑制的怒火和大发雷霆。

en.t: I thought: this time, what awaited me was the teacher's uncontrollable anger and furious outburst.

units.source_text: 就是被拳打脚踢，落到流血的窘境，我也不会后悔。

en.t: Even if I were punched and kicked and ended up bleeding in that miserable state, I would not regret it.
